info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Human Resources Direction Management API
info.description: The Human Resources Direction Management API allows organizations to effectively update and manage human resource directives within the banking sector. This endpoint enables the modification of specific HR policies and guidelines, ensuring they are current and relevant. Typical consumers include HR professionals and administrative personnel in banks who need to adjust HR strategies in response to changing requirements. Utilize this API to maintain streamlined operations and ensure compliance within your HR processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific Human Resources direction identified by the resource ID. Use this functionality to make necessary changes to the HR direction attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to send a partial update to the human resources record identified by RES-100045. It should include only the fields that need to be updated. The provided data must conform to the specified schema to ensure all required validations are met.
